name: Kim
summary: 39, developer with a repetitive strain injury. Cannot use a mouse; navigates entirely with the keyboard (Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, arrows, Escape).
context: At your desk with a split keyboard. A mouse is not an option today; your wrist is bad.
temperament: Methodical and technical. Notices exactly where focus goes. Gets sharp when something can't be reached by keyboard.
